The [[Deldrimor Scepter (unique)|Deldrimor Scepter]] is a [[unique item|unique]] [[wand]] traded by the appropriate Artisan, [[collector]]s in [[Droknar's Forge (explorable area)]]. It is available for all caster [[attribute]]s.

== Stats ==
:<[[Damage type|Type]]> damage: 11-22 (Requires 9 <[[attribute]]>)
:Halves skill recharge of <attribute> [[spell]]s (Chance: 20%)
:[[Energy]] +5 (while [[Health]] is above 50%) 

== Skin ==
This item uses the same [[skin]] as the non-unique [[Deldrimor Scepter]].

==Replica==
It is possible to create an exact replica for this item with:
*[[Deldrimor Scepter]] of the appropriate attribute from crafter [[Grand Mason Stonecleaver]]
*[[Perfect]] [[Wand Wrapping]] [[of Memory]]
*Perfect [["Hale and Hearty"]] inscription


Except for the visual appearance, it is possible to create an exact replica of this item with:
*One of the following [[wand]]s of the appropriate attribute:
**[[Destroyer Scepter]] from crafter [[Balthor Coalforge]]
**[[Imperial Scepter]] from collector [[Shen Xi]]
**[[Tormented Scepter]] from collector [[Deacon of Whispers]]
*Perfect [["Hale and Hearty"]] inscription
OR
*One of the following wands of the appropriate attribute:
**[[Asuran Scepter]] from crafter [[Nojj]]
**[[Balthazar's Rod]] from collector [[Zaishen Weapon Master]]
**[[Fan of Purity]] from collector [[Iza Yoi]]
**[[Norn Scepter]] from crafter [[Keti]]
**[[Oppressor's Scepter]] from collector [[Lionguard (collector)|Lionguard]]
**Wand from crafters [[Asa]], [[Derrick]], [[Hadusi]], [[Shausha]], [[Soros]], or [[Tehshan]]
**[[Charr Scepter]] from collector [[Tuomas]] (requires [[Bonus Mission Pack]])
**[[Mursaat Scepter]] from collector [[Diane]] (requires Bonus Mission Pack)
**[[Tengu Scepter]] from collector [[Akemi]] (requires Bonus Mission Pack)
**[[Undead Scepter]] from collector [[Archivist of Whispers]] (requires Bonus Mission Pack)
*Perfect [[Wand Wrapping]] [[of Memory]]
*Perfect [["Hale and Hearty"]] inscription

*[[Gordac's Needle]] has stats identical to the [[Blood Magic]] version of this item.
*[[Tain's Corruption]] has stats identical to the [[Curses]] version of this item.

*[[The Dream Haunter]] and [[Yamesh's Anguish]] have stats identical to the [[Illusion Magic]] version of this item.
*[[Wieshur's Inspiration]] has stats identical to the [[Inspiration Magic]] version of this item.
*[[Seacrash's Influence]] and [[Zarnas' Wrath]] have stats identical to the [[Earth Magic]] version of this item.
*[[Prismatic Rod]] and [[Setikor's Scepter]] have stats identical to the [[Energy Storage]] version of this item.
*[[Ilsundur's Rod]] has stats identical to the [[Fire Magic]] version of this item.
*[[Flint's Wand]], [[Shatterstone (unique)|Shatterstone]], [[The Stonebreaker (wand)|The Stonebreaker]], and [[Antiquated Rod]] have stats identical to the [[Water Magic]] version of this item.
*[[Podaltur's Fury]] has stats identical to the [[Channeling Magic]] version of this item.
*[[Vengeance Seeker]] has stats identical to the [[Communing]] version of this item.
